items.details: Flew from Duesseldorf to Abu Dhabi with Air Berlin in the evening; travel organized via LTUR (thanked on the blog).

items.details: Diary Day 1 title: 'Camel Kisses, Desert Safari & City Tour'.
items.name: Desert Safari

items.details: Tip: go right before sunset for the most stunning scenes; wear something long (free cover-up rental available at the entrance).
items.name: Sheikh Zayed Grand Mosque

items.details: Sand boarding tried out during the desert safari: 'looks easier than it really is but a lot of fun'.
items.name: Sand Boarding

items.details: Tip: go for a ride on the fastest rollercoaster in the world; only two members of her group had time to see it.

items.name: Yas Mall shopping

items.details: Diary Day 3: 'Formula 1 Race, Fireworks & Cheesecake Factory'.
items.name: Formula 1 race with evening fireworks

items.details: Her favorites: Oreo Dream Extreme Cheesecake and Ultimate Red Velvet Cheesecake. 'Also all other food is amazing there.'
items.name: Cheesecake Factory

items.details: Transport tips: only enter taxis with a working taximeter (drivers took detours or overcharged); taxis are cheap but cash-only - withdraw enough cash beforehand (four ATMs ran out of cash on F1 race day).

itineraries.summary: Madeleine's three full days in Abu Dhabi: camel kisses, desert safari with sand boarding and a city tour on day one; the Grand Mosque at sunset and Yas Mall on day two; the Formula 1 race, fireworks and Cheesecake Factory on day three, flying home at 6am the next morning. Her Top 10 tips add practical detail (Ferrari World, taxi/cash rules) and note the trip ran through LTUR.
itineraries.title: Abu Dhabi Travel Diary - 3 Days

items.details: 'Flying makes definitely sense' - much more comfortable and faster than the ferry to Nelson.

items.details: Booked the full-day tour (almost entire day) with a group of ~10; 'the guides are really amazing'.

itineraries.summary: Madeleine's New Zealand trip segment: flying Auckland to Nelson, eating at the harbour-side Boat Shed, then two days in Abel Tasman National Park - one night at Abel Tasman Marahau Lodge and a second night aboard the Aqua Packers boat hostel near Anchorage Beach, with hiking, a full-day kayaking tour and the water taxi between beaches. Recommendation-style post, not a strict day-by-day plan.
itineraries.title: New Zealand: Nelson & Abel Tasman Travel Tips

extractions.notes: Solo pilot/travel blogger; her blog pilotmadeleine.de (linked from her Instagram bio) is the primary source. All three itineraries come from her own day-by-day travel diaries and trip-tips posts - genuine named-trip content with destinations, named hotels/restaurants/activities. Day counts: Hawaii total length and the NZ total length are not stated, so those are null per the honesty rules.

Identity check performed: Rachid Dahnoun is an adventure/outdoor photographer (Lowepro Global Ambassador; work in National Geographic, Backpacker, NYT; studios in South Lake Tahoe/Healdsburg, CA), NOT a tour operator. The day-by-day Morocco itineraries found under 'Rachid Morocco Tours' (Medium/Substack) are a different, Morocco-based tour operator with a coincidentally similar name - deliberately NOT attributed to him. Dahnoun's own content is photography and occasional workshops with no extractable trip plans, so no itineraries were recorded rather than forcing one.

itineraries.destination: Best of Europe (Netherlands, Germany, Austria, Italy, Switzerland, France)

items.details: Arrive via Amsterdam airport; 3pm hotel orientation in Haarlem, Haarlem walking tour, traditional rijsttafel dinner and Jenever tasting. Sleep Haarlem.
items.name: Welcome to the Netherlands

items.details: Train to Amsterdam; Anne Frank House, walking tour of historic streets, canal boat cruise, Rijksmuseum (Rembrandt, Vermeer). Optional Van Gogh Museum. Sleep Haarlem.
items.name: Progressive, Artistic Amsterdam

items.details: Arnhem open-air museum (houses, windmills) and traditional pancake lunch; drive down to Bacharach on the Rhine for dinner. Sleep Bacharach.
items.name: Dutch Treats and Rhine Views

items.details: Bacharach walking tour, hike to Rheinfels Castle at St. Goar, Rhine River cruise past villages and castles. Sleep Bacharach.
items.name: Rhine Castles and a River Cruise

items.details: Romantic Road to Rothenburg, Germany's best-preserved medieval town; Riemenschneider altarpiece, medieval wall walk; Night Watchman tour in the evening. Sleep Rothenburg.
items.name: Medieval Rothenburg

items.details: Dachau Concentration Camp Memorial near Munich, then drive across Bavaria into Austria to Salzburg. Sleep Salzburg.
items.name: Dachau and Salzburg

items.details: Salzburg walking tour (Mozart's steps), lunch and Apfelstrudel baking lesson; free time for fortress hill or Sound of Music tour. Sleep Salzburg.
items.name: Salzburg and Strudel

items.details: All-day drive over the Austrian Alps to Venice; vaporetto Grand Canal ride; alleys-and-canals orientation stroll. Optional gondola ride. Sleep Venice.
items.name: Italy's Incomparable Venice

items.details: Venice walking tour ending in St. Mark's Square; free afternoon for St. Mark's Basilica, Doge's Palace or Accademia. Sleep Venice.
items.name: The Art of Wandering in Venice

items.details: Drive to Florence; Renaissance walking tour (Brunelleschi's dome, Baptistery doors) ending at the Accademia Gallery for Michelangelo's David. Sleep Florence.
items.name: Florence and Michelangelo's David

items.details: Free morning, then afternoon tour of the Uffizi Gallery (Botticelli, Leonardo, Raphael). Sleep Florence.
items.name: Wonders of Renaissance Florence

items.details: Drive to Rome; walking tour through Colosseum (exterior), Roman Forum and Pantheon; evening stroll through floodlit Rome to Trevi Fountain. Sleep Rome.
items.name: A Walk Through Caesar's Rome

items.details: Vatican City and St. Peter's Basilica (Michelangelo's Pieta); free afternoon for Vatican Museums/Sistine Chapel. Sleep Rome.
items.name: Vatican City and St. Peter's Basilica

items.details: Italian hill town en route, then train into Monterosso al Mare on the Cinque Terre; feast of local specialties (homemade pesto, fresh catch). Sleep Monterosso al Mare.
items.name: To Italy's Cinque Terre

items.details: 'Vacation from your vacation' - free day in the five fishing villages; cliffside hiking paths between towns. Sleep Monterosso al Mare.
items.name: Free Day in the Cinque Terre

items.details: Train and bus over northern Italy into Switzerland; chalet in the Lauterbrunnen Valley. Sleep Lauterbrunnen Valley.
items.name: To the Heart of the Swiss Alps

items.details: Free day: alpine walk above the tree line, gondola to the Schilthorn (10,000 ft), or Trummelbach Falls. Sleep Lauterbrunnen Valley.
items.name: Free Day in the Alps

items.details: Drive to Burgundy; Beaune orientation walk, Hôtel Dieu medieval hospital visit, wine tasting. Sleep Beaune.
items.name: A Hearty Taste of Burgundy

items.details: Drive to Paris; Ile de la Cité, Notre-Dame and Sainte-Chapelle with a local guide, Latin Quarter. Sleep Paris.
items.name: Historic and Neighborhood Paris

items.details: Louvre Museum (Mona Lisa, Winged Victory, Venus de Milo); free afternoon (Orsay, Rodin, Champs-Elysées); farewell dinner. Sleep Paris.
items.name: Parisian Cityscapes and Masterpieces

items.details: Tour over after breakfast; optional Versailles day trip or airport transfers.
items.name: Tour ends

itineraries.summary: Rick Steves' flagship 21-day guided tour: Netherlands to Paris across six countries (Amsterdam, Rhine Valley, Rothenburg, Salzburg, Venice, Florence, Rome, Cinque Terre, Swiss Alps, Burgundy, Paris). Full day-by-day itinerary from ricksteves.com; from $7,145 per person + air (single supplement $1,260), 20 nights' accommodation, 32+ group sightseeing events, all breakfasts and half the dinners included. It is a commercial group tour, but the named day-by-day itinerary is his flagship promoted route.
itineraries.title: Best of Europe in 21 Days Tour

extractions.notes: Cultural-travel influencer with extensive free itineraries on ricksteves.com. Both are verbatim day-by-day plans from his own site - high confidence.

items.details: Start in Moab, head north to Arches National Park; hike to Delicate Arch; settle into reserved campsite at Devils Garden; evening stroll on Devils Garden Trail.
items.name: Arches National Park (Delicate Arch)

items.details: Explore Canyonlands' Island in the Sky District (Grand View Point, Colorado River overlooks); cliff-edge hike. Camp at Dead Horse Point State Park; mountain biking there.
items.name: Island in the Sky and Dead Horse Point

items.details: US-191 south to the Needles District of Canyonlands; BLM Newspaper Rock petroglyph site off the access road; east on UT-95 across Cedar Mesa to campground at Natural Bridges National Monument.
items.name: Needles District and Natural Bridges

items.details: UT-95 north to Hanksville, UT-24 west to Capitol Reef - 'one of the National Park Service's unsung heroes' with the pioneer Fruita orchards.
items.name: Capitol Reef

items.details: Scenic Highway 12 (Torrey to Escalante, 61 miles); Anasazi State Park ruins; hike Lower Calf Creek Falls Trail to a waterfall.
items.name: Highway 12 and Escalante Canyons

items.details: Hole-in-the-Rock Road to Devil's Garden; optional slot canyons of Dry Fork of Coyote Gulch (26 bumpy miles).
items.name: Devil's Garden and slot canyons

items.details: West on Highway 12 to Bryce Canyon; park shuttle to vista points; hoodoo trails.
items.name: Bryce Canyon

items.details: Sunrise over the hoodoos; drive Highway 12 to US-89, Highway 9, enter Zion via the Zion-Mount Carmel Highway (84 miles); settle into reserved campsite; park shuttle overview of Zion Canyon.
items.name: Bryce to Zion

itineraries.summary: Nine-day road trip through Utah's national parks from the roadtripusa.com site: Moab to Arches, Canyonlands' Island in the Sky and Needles districts, Natural Bridges, Capitol Reef, the scenic Highway 12 to Escalante, Bryce Canyon and Zion. Written by Moon Utah authors W.C. McRae and Judy Jewell; full day-by-day drive routes with campsite guidance - a classic structured road-trip itinerary.
itineraries.title: Utah Road Trip: 9 Days in the Parks

extractions.notes: Road-trip brand account; roadtripusa.com publishes structured trip ideas. Extracted the fully day-by-day Utah national parks route (days 1-9 with drive directions and campsites). Other pages (e.g. coastal drives list, book promos) are lists/promos, not single itineraries, so only the Utah one qualified.

items.details: 2023 Outremer 45 performance catamaran 'Falmari' (48ft, 2 queen cabins, max 4 guests, captain + optional chef). Booking page is the trip page itself.
items.name: Sailing yacht Falmari
items.price_hint: The Holiday full-yacht charter from $15,450 for 2 guests ($16,450 for 4) +14% Bahamian charter tax for 6 nights; Learn-the-Ropes shared trips $8,250/cabin; ASA certification +$600/person

items.details: Fly into Leonard Thompson Airport (MHH) in Marsh Harbor; board Sunday at 3:00 PM; safety briefing, then sail to nearby Guana Cay for the first night at anchor.
items.name: Board and sail to Guana Cay

items.details: Snorkel Fowl Cay (coral-head caves and tunnels, free diving); Man-O-War Cay - historic boat building capital of the islands.
items.name: Fowl Cay snorkeling and Man-O-War Cay

items.details: Explore the quaint township of Hope Town on Elbow Cay; walk to the Atlantic side's white sand beach. Firefly restaurant is 'the best spot to catch sunset with a sundowner'. Anchor at Tahiti Beach.
items.name: Firefly restaurant

items.details: Head south; lunch at 'the famously fun Pete's Pub'; explore the small artist community and bronze sculptures from the foundry; anchor for the night.
items.name: Pete's Pub

items.details: Snorkel the Sandy Cay coral reef (turtles, eagle rays, loads of fish); sail to Lynyard Cay for the evening, anchor in pristine waters.
items.name: Sandy Cay reef and Lynyard Cay

items.details: Leisurely morning at Lynyard Cay; sail back into the base marina at Marsh Harbour; dinner on shore on the last night aboard.
items.name: Return to Marsh Harbour

items.details: Last morning on the boat; disembark by 10:00 AM.
items.name: Disembark

itineraries.summary: A 6-night / 7-day sailing itinerary in the Abaco Islands aboard the Outremer 45 catamaran Falmari, bookable through Vagabonde Adventures - the trip brand promoted in Sailing La Vagabonde's own YouTube episode descriptions ('BOOK A TRIP with VagabondeAdventures'). Day-by-day: Marsh Harbor to Guana Cay, Fowl Cay snorkeling, Hope Town, Little Harbour's Pete's Pub, Sandy Cay reef and Lynyard Cay, then back to Marsh Harbour. Sailing season November-May, 70-78 degF.
itineraries.title: Sail in the Abaco Islands, Bahamas - 7 Day Itinerary

extractions.notes: SLV's own channel content is voyage vlogs (episode chapters), not structured itineraries - their passages don't form day-by-day plans, so those were not forced. The one extractable structured itinerary is Vagabonde Adventures' bookable 7-day Abaco trip, which SLV actively promotes in their official YouTube episode descriptions. Affiliation caveat: vagabondeadventures.com is a separate booking site, promoted by SLV as their trip brand; the extraction is honest about that link.
